name: 實原
description: Sanehara　現在締切を３ヶ月いただいています。ゆっくり待っててね。

works.body:
It's nice to meet you.
I saw your work on Skeb and I really admire your artwork. I would like to request a drawing of my OC, if possible.

This girl is my original character, and her name is “Guillotine” (simply because she likes the name). She claims to be a doll maid from Russia, but in reality she’s just an ordinary girl who talks nonsense. She isn’t actually a maid either—she just likes wearing maid outfits.

The illustration will be used for my personal collection and possibly as an avatar on social apps.
I leave everything in your hands, and you may draw her however you like.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RQqEU9G7TF2xwGyPYSYHZq3WhBXyohgg?usp=sharing
